描述_EN: story dice are designed to encourage imagination by linking the images displayed on the upturned faces into an adventure story. pirate stories have been popular with children for more than two hundred years. over time, the content of children’s pirate stories became increasingly sanitised and stereotyped, removing fictional pirates from their unsavoury historic origins.children’s pirate stories tend to make use of a number of similar themes and elements, and this object distils them into a single game, whilst adding the modern twist of enabling the player to gain superpowers. they offer the appeal of romantic and exciting adventures across the seas to mysterious lands, fighting dreaded rivals and obtaining rich treasures, with pirates playing the roles of heroes, anti-heroes, or outright villains.
描述_ZN: 故事骰子的设计是为了鼓励想象力，将翻转的面孔上显示的图像连接到一个冒险故事中。 海盗故事在儿童中流行了两百多年。 随着时间的推移，儿童海盗故事的内容变得越来越神圣和刻板，使虚构的海盗脱离了他们不光彩的历史渊源。儿童海盗故事往往利用一些类似的主题和元素，这个对象将它们提炼成一个单一的游戏，同时增加了现代的扭曲，使玩家能够获得超能力。 它们提供了浪漫和令人兴奋的冒险的吸引力，跨越海洋到神秘的土地，与可怕的对手战斗并获得丰富的宝藏，海盗扮演着英雄、反英雄或彻底的恶棍的角色。
